morgan: FYI PR #3427 (sdk-snippets) is blocked — docs preview linkcheck failed. anyone available to review + re-run preview?

sai: on reviewer rotation but tied up until 11:20 PT, can take it after if nobody else.

anya: I can do a quick pass on the snippets now and re-run the preview.

morgan: thanks @anya! the linkcheck output points to a broken anchor in migration-guide.md — looks like `#what-to-update` was removed in last refactor.

anya: grabbing it. will push a tiny fix to add the anchor back or update the link.

ci-bot: docs-preview started for PR #3427 (run_id: 5873) 

anya: found the source — anchor renamed to `#upgrade-steps`. updating link to use the canonical header and adding a short note in the SDK snippet about batching caveat. will force-push in a sec.

morgan: pasting the linkcheck snippet so others see the failure:
```
Linkcheck failed:
ERROR: /docs/migration-guide.md: broken link - #what-to-update -> 404
```

anya: pushed fix (force-push). kicking preview: `/run docs-preview pr-3427`

ci-bot: docs-preview queued -> running (run_id: 5874). logs: linkcheck -> OK, lint -> OK, build -> OK.

julian: quick note — merge window today at 16:00 UTC. if preview stays green we should merge before the window closes; otherwise tag QA for a manual sign-off.

sai: if someone can approve while i'm in meetings, tag me and i'll add final sign-off when i'm free.

anya: preview is green :white_check_mark:. added a one-line changelog entry and a short remark in sdk/snippets/batching.md. ready for review.

morgan: i'll take the review now and merge if everything looks good. thanks @anya for the quick turnaround. :thumbsup:

ci-bot: PR #3427 merged by morgan (merge_commit: a1b2c3d). changelog bumped.

morgan: merged and released to staging — please shout if anything odd shows up in examples or the migration guide.

anya: noted, will follow up with a small automated test to prevent regression on that anchor.

sai: great teamwork, thanks all.
